principles: Show eligibility and expiration when real
Use consult-required language for scoped services
Do not pressure emergency/security buyers with manipulative countdowns

promotionTypes.label: Bundle savings
promotionTypes.description: Show savings when a bundle includes multiple eligible products. Use real calculated comparison only.

promotionTypes.label: Quick-win starter credit
promotionTypes.description: Credit part of a quick-win purchase toward an eligible larger bundle or monthly plan.

promotionTypes.label: Seasonal readiness offer
promotionTypes.description: Use only for real seasonal service windows such as pre-season marina readiness or end-of-year security reviews.

promotionTypes.label: New client foundation offer
promotionTypes.description: Introductory bundle incentive for first-time managed service prospects.

promotionTypes.label: Limited capacity notice
promotionTypes.description: Use only when scheduling capacity is genuinely limited. Avoid fake scarcity.

promotionTypes.label: Included add-on
promotionTypes.description: Add a clearly scoped bonus such as uptime monitor setup with website care or DNS documentation with Cloudflare setup.

displayPatterns.label: Price-adjacent badge
displayPatterns.where: Product cards and product detail hero

displayPatterns.label: Bundle compare panel
copyExamples: Includes the most common next steps

displayPatterns.label: Ethical FOMO panel
copyExamples: Limited onsite slots this month if capacity is true

displayPatterns.label: Quick-win ladder
displayPatterns.where: Store landing and product detail pages
copyExamples: Start small, apply what you learn, upgrade when ready

disallowed: Aggressive fear copy for cyber incidents
Any copy that implies guaranteed compliance or immunity from breaches
required: End date when there is a real end date
